description: Thumbnails that carry no image — video title cards and text-only frames. Open Research grabs its poster from the opening frame, which for these is a title slide or a page of writing. Keyed by eprint id, listing the deposited filename. Dropped during normalize.
reviewing: Pixel statistics cannot tell these apart from legitimate minimal work: eprint 5121's 'AWORM' title card and eprint 214's point-cloud form have near-identical histograms, as do eprint 746's title card and eprint 221's photograph on a white background. So this list is curated by eye — after a data refresh, scan the Media page for tiles that are only text and add them here.
